purpose: Separate direct deictic dependence of current L2 expressions from domain-bounded replay evidence and from candidate transitive dependence through explicit definition-opening graphs.

researchVocabulary.directDeictic: typed AST contains ContextPronoun; exact source spelling/span is irrelevant
researchVocabulary.noDirectDeictic: typed AST contains no ContextPronoun; this is not a theorem of global context invariance
researchVocabulary.candidateIndirectDeictic: an explicitly requested finite definition-opening dependency closure reaches a body containing ContextPronoun
researchVocabulary.observableInvariantOnDomain: independent replay is equal for every explicitly enumerated challenged ContextFrame while all other inputs are fixed
researchVocabulary.observableSensitive: there exists an explicit challenged context pair with different replay result
researchVocabulary.unknown: available accepted operations/evidence do not justify either invariance or dependence claim

candidateModels.soundClaimBoundary: may detect direct ContextPronoun occurrence only; may not conclude universal context invariance from absence
follows only canonical open_definition edges in a finite explicit DefinitionEnvironment; this models a possible future composition dependency and is not current interpret semantics
may establish sensitivity by counterexample or invariance only over the explicitly serialized finite context domain
interpreter/session/security metadata is not a hidden semantic dependency

observableReplayBoundary.resultComparison: success + grounded holes + aliases; trace text is diagnostic and not required as semantic identity

requiredVectors: [] = [] has no direct ContextPronoun and replays identically for at least two distinct explicit ContextFrames
◁ = a is direct-deictic and has an explicit replay counterexample across two frames
↑◁ = a is direct-deictic with parent-depth one
definition a : b and b : ◁ yields candidate indirect deictic dependence only through explicit one-step opening closure
self definition a : a terminates by DefinitionId cycle detection
mutual definitions a : b and b : a terminate by finite DefinitionId graph
missing initial definition target yields unknown rather than invariant
whitespace and SourceSpan changes do not change direct effect classification
same explicit context and non-context inputs replay identically under different test-only interpreter labels
analysis and replay do not mutate L4 or DefinitionEnvironment
vetoes: no pronoun implies universal context invariance
automatic definition unfolding inside current interpret semantics
source span or display text as semantic identity
interpreter identity as hidden effect input
new trusted ContextInvariant proof relation before acceptance
editing published v0.3/v0.4 contracts in place

mustDecide: whether direct typed-AST deictic detection becomes a normative analysis operation
whether definition dependency analysis waits for accepted L5 composition or is accepted as a separate static relation
the exact domain and equality notion for any ContextInvariant claim
whether Unknown is mandatory for unresolved future composition dependencies
whether any dependency result belongs in trusted proof artifacts
